description: S458 2a-fix F2: a refined CELL is judged at the runtime write path, so every write is checked wherever it originates — an inline handler (`onclick=${@n = @m}`), a field write (`@l.n = -5`), an in-place `push`, `@n--` from 1, `Object.assign(@l, …)`, a block-bodied arrow in a function, and an `<each>` row handler. Each write throws E-CONTRACT-001-RT and the cell keeps its prior value. In slice 2a every one of these was admitted (the obligations were patched into AST positions, and these positions were missed).
rationale: §53.3.3: "the compiler-generated check SHALL throw a runtime error with code E-CONTRACT-001-RT before the assignment is applied. The variable retains its prior value." §53.6.2: "the type predicate fires at every assignment".
